title: He Found a Vibrating Cave, Then Vanished
sources: Wikipedia, 'Disappearance of Kenny Veach': Las Vegas hiker and YouTuber; in 2014 wrote in a YouTube comment about an M-shaped cave entrance in the Sheep Range that made his body vibrate more the closer he got, and he went back to his car scared; a second trip in October 2014 failed; last seen November 10, 2014 near Nellis Air Force Base; his car was found at the trailhead and his phone on November 22, 2014 near an old mine shaft; never found
Nevada Magazine (Sept-Oct 2019), 'M Cave and the unexplained disappearance of Kenny Veach' (travelnevada.com)
